title: In-person vs. Virtual Delivery of a Group-based Prevention of Postpartum Depression
official: Group-based Prevention of Postpartum Depression: In-person vs. Virtual Delivery
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to test whether an established preventive intervention (group interpersonal therapy) delivered virtually shows the same benefits for preventing postpartum depression as it does when delivered in person.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English or Spanish speaking
* Less than 30 gestational weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
